quote.text: Facts are stubborn things; and whatever may be our wishes, our inclinations, or the dictates of our passions, they cannot alter the state of facts and evidence.
quote.author: John Adams, defending the British soldiers after the Boston Massacre, December 1770

stories.headline: Washington Declares an "Economic D-Day" on Iran. The Oil Price Fell.
stories.dek: Treasury turned its six-month war on Tehran into a financial offensive on Monday, naming close to sixty firms, people and vessels — several of them Chinese. Iran threatened to shut the Gulf. Crude dropped almost four per cent. The market read the drama and priced de-escalation.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The Pivot Being Priced
stories.headline: Gold Holds a Three-Month High, the Long Bond Is Rescued by Its Own Issuer, and the Market Front-Runs a Pivot
stories.dek: A soft dollar, fading hike odds and a Treasury funding its own long end have lifted gold and bitcoin together before a new Fed chair even speaks. The whole regime rests on Friday's tone in Jackson Hole — and tonight's number out of one chip company.

stories.headline: The Hobby Where You Buy a Pair of Ears a Better Recording
stories.dek: It starts the same way for everyone: a track you've heard a thousand times, and suddenly a cymbal decays into a room, a breath sits before a vocal line. That "I never heard that before" is the hook — and the beginning of a very deep, very expensive descent.

stories.kicker: Singapore · The Republic & The West Bank
stories.headline: Singapore Calls the E1 Settlement Plan "Illegal" — a Firm Word, and the Limits of One
stories.dek: The Foreign Ministry told Israel to halt an expansion that would "further fragment the West Bank." It is the Republic's settled position, stated plainly — and, unlike several European partners, unaccompanied by any material lever.

stories.headline: A Knife Is Three Decisions Stacked: Steel, Hardness, Geometry — and None of Them Is the Badge
stories.dek: Learn the mechanism and you can judge any blade cold. The premium is real up to a point, then it turns into damascus for the eye and a name for the drawer. Buy the geometry, learn to sharpen, and one gyuto will outlast the kitchen.

stories.kicker: Technology · The Number the Market Priced
stories.headline: One Company Reports Tonight, and the Whole AI Trade Is the Wager
stories.dek: Nvidia's quarter lands after the US close — too late for this page, early enough for the market's nerves. The guide is ninety-one billion dollars; the real question is whether the infrastructure boom has a ceiling. Two other stories say the walls are closing in anyway.

stories.headline: Garmin's fēnix Goes Titanium, Satellite and Brighter — and Four Figures
stories.dek: The leak was right. The fēnix 9 lands from US$999 with a 3,000-nit screen and 64 gigabytes of storage; the Pro adds a titanium case and inReach satellite messaging from the wrist. The reviewers were still gagged at launch, and the owners are already unimpressed.

stories.headline: An Akita Workshop Drops Its Price by Two-Thirds — and Tells You What You're Buying
stories.dek: Minase, famous for a mirror polish few can match, put a Japanese movement in the Mastercraft J3 and priced it near US$2,150 — a third of its usual ask. It is an honest luxury: you are paying for the finishing, and the brand says so.

stories.headline: A Seoul Group Turns Ten and Sweeps the Charts Overnight
stories.dek: NCT 127's seventh album landed for the group's tenth anniversary and topped iTunes in a dozen markets by the next morning. Whether a day-one fandom sweep becomes a lasting hit is the question the charts can't yet answer — and a Djokovic film is waiting on the critics for the same reason.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · The Ban and the Behaviour
stories.headline: Australia Removed Five Million Teen Accounts. Eight in Ten Are Still Online.
stories.dek: The world's toughest social-media age law is nine months old, and the monitoring says the ban leaks. For a Singapore parent whose child just started Secondary One — as school phone rules also tighten — the lesson is that the gate does less work than the household does.

stories.kicker: Fitness · The Craze Meets the Trial
stories.headline: The Weighted Vest Had Its Moment. Its Best Trial Just Deflated It.
stories.dek: Rucking and weighted vests are everywhere in the longevity crowd. A twelve-month randomised trial finds the load did not save the hip during weight loss — and lost to plain resistance training for muscle. The vest is a supplement to lifting, not a substitute.

stories.headline: What's Worth Booking — Home and Away
The Numbing Thaw
stories.dek: As Tokyo and Beijing sink to their coldest point in a decade, young Japanese women are queuing for the most identifiably Chinese food to arrive in a generation — a build-your-own Sichuan soup called malatang. The states are freezing. The culture is not.
